concept.verdict: Slender stepped mast, copper neck, red side housing and jade palette agree with legacy. Concept thickens pad/rim and changes round brass fitting to an oblong plate; reject these anatomy changes and retain established profiles.

concept_attempts.outcome: No image returned; built-in output moderation rejected the request.

feedback: Actual independent GLB retains the low stepped circular pad, narrow pedestal/mast, copper spindle with dark/red module, enlarged head and straight segmented terminal seen in legacy.

Six protected profile/spindle components retain exact evaluated geometry, five measured dents, all colour/roughness pixels and twelve planar cap UV surfaces. Reduction affects only the small cast fitting bezel; all thirty-two flange-root attachment samples remain valid.

Concept has a thicker base rim and oblong fitting absent from the established source-guided model. These changes are rejected. Existing wear is subtler than the concept and remains readable in close views.

Catalogue phases reveal/highlight the same static tower. No mechanical cycle is established; shared RIS2 construction remains separate. Exact hidden sections, underside and ambiguous pedestal shadow remain inferred rather than recovered.

Saved-native and independent GLB views have exact alpha and threshold silhouettes. Recorded RGB differences are measured below; game scale, Android performance and final artistic acceptance remain unproved.
